providers.title: Twisted cancellation
providers.scope: A coefficient alpha on [H_m, 2H_m] has twisted cancellation if, for all fixed A_0, B, A, the sums (1/H_m) sum alpha_m chi(m) m^(it) are O(L^(-A)) for every character chi of modulus at most L^(A_0) and every |t| <= 2X L^B.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The marked Type II estimate
providers.scope: Let H_m, H_n >= x^delta with X = H_m H_n comparable to x, let alpha be supported on W-rough integers in [H_m, 2H_m] with |alpha| <= L^C and twisted cancellation, beta on W-rough integers in [H_n, 2H_n] with |beta| <= L^C, and F group-invariant with |F| <= 1. Then the sum of alpha_m beta_n F(mn - 1) W(mn - 1) is O(X L^(-D_*)) for K >= K_0 = 200(2D_* + 4C + 11) and every choice of band exponents. Proved in lessons 2 to 17.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Prime predecessors
providers.scope: The coefficient m^(iv)(1_prime(m) - 1_rough(m)/(V(W) log m)) on an interval of [H_m, 2H_m], |v| <= L^C, satisfies the hypotheses of Theorem 2.2; so the marked bilinear sums with this coefficient are O(X L^(-D_*)) for K >= K_0, uniformly in the interval and in v.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Primes in progressions on short ranges
providers.scope: For x^delta_1 <= N <= x^(1/delta_1), q <= L^(A_0) and (a, q) = 1, the primes p = a mod q in an interval of [N, 2N] number (1/phi(q)) times the integral of dy/log y over it, up to O(N L^(-A)); character sums over these primes have the principal-character main term only.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Divisors in a progression
providers.scope: For l, H' >= 1 with 1 + lH' <= Z, the sum over h <= H' of tau(1 + lh)^2 is at most 4H'(1 + log Z)^3 + 4Z^(3/4)(1 + log Z)^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Well-spaced mean values
providers.scope: For a Dirichlet polynomial of length Y and 1-separated points in an interval of length T, the sum of |P(t)|^2 is at most 2(T + 1 + 6 pi Y)(1 + log^2 Y) times the squared coefficient norm, with absolute constants.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rough integers twisted by characters
providers.scope: For x^delta_1 <= H <= x^(1/delta_1) and characters chi of modulus at most L^(A_0), the sum of chi(n) over W-rough n in an interval of [H, 2H] is 1_(chi principal) V(W) times its length, up to O(H L^(-A)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Logarithmic phases with bounded height ratio
providers.scope: For fixed Lambda >= 1, H >= 2, 0 <= u <= 1 and 1 <= |t| <= H^Lambda, every sum of (n + u)^(it) over an interval of [H, 2H] is O(H/|t| + H^(1 - c_Lambda)), with c_Lambda = 1/(d 2^(d+2)) and d = ceil(Lambda).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Logarithmic phases on progressions
providers.scope: For x^delta_1 <= N <= x^Lambda_1, q <= L^(C_0) and 1 <= |t| <= x^Lambda_1, the sum of n^(it) over n = a mod q in an interval of [N, 2N] is O((N/q)(1/|t| + x^(-c))), with c = c(delta_1, Lambda_1) > 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A mean value theorem with uniform constants
providers.scope: For every k >= 2 some s with k <= s <= C_1 k^3 satisfies J_(s,k)(M) <= exp(C_1 k^(C_2)) M^(2s - k(k+1)/2 + 1/100) for all M >= 1, with absolute constants C_1, C_2; proved by Linnik's p-adic iteration.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Logarithmic phases at large height
providers.scope: With T = log L, for exp(L/T^2) <= N <= 2x^5, q <= L^(C_0) and exp(L/(2T^2)) <= |v| <= 4x^3, every sum of n^(iv) over n = a mod q in an interval of [N, 2N] is at most (N/q) exp(-L/T^10).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A zero-free strip at large height
providers.scope: With T = log L, no Dirichlet L-function of modulus at most L^(C_0) vanishes in Re s >= 1 - cT^2/L, 1 <= |Im s| <= x^3, for some c = c(C_0) > 0; and |L'/L(s, chi)| = O(L) for 1 - cT^2/(2L) <= Re s <= 1 + 1/L, 2 <= |Im s| <= x^3/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Long prime polynomials
providers.scope: For x^tau/2 <= N <= x^(1/tau), characters of modulus at most L^(C_0) and L^(A+8) <= |t| <= x^2, the sum of chi(p) p^(-1+it) over the primes of any interval in [N, 2N] is O(L^(-A)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The prime coefficient has twisted cancellation
providers.scope: For alpha_m = m^(iv)(1_prime(m) - 1_rough(m)/(V(W) log m)) on an interval of [H_m, 2H_m], (1/H_m) sum alpha_m chi(m) m^(it) = O(L^(-A)) for characters of modulus at most L^(A_0) and |t| <= 2X L^B, uniformly in the interval and in |v| <= L^C.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Cauchy reduction
providers.scope: If the expanded squares Q_Y are O(XY L^(-D_1)) for every dyadic Y in range, the marked bilinear form is O(X L^(0.2 - D_1/2)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The determinant equation
providers.scope: For coprime a, b and mn >= 2, there is an integer h with mn - 1 = ah and rs - 1 = bh if and only if bmn - ars = b - a.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two remaining estimates
providers.scope: Theorem 2.2 of lesson 1 follows from bounds O(XY L^(-2D_* - 2)) for the minor part Q_Y^min and the major part Q_Y^maj of the determinant equation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Most ratios are good
providers.scope: For fixed lists, the ratios r for which a state fails one of the two Diophantine tests (G1), (G2) form a set of measure at most exp(-c L^0.1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Stripping the pads
providers.scope: The minor sum Q_Y^min equals the sum over the pad dyads d_0 of <f, T g>/d_0, up to O(XY L^(-A)) for every fixed A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Compression by arbitrary vectors
providers.scope: For a positive semidefinite B and arbitrary vectors v_P, <sum c_P v_P, B sum c_Q v_Q> <= (sum_P <v_P, B v_P>) sum |c_P|^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: From the moment to the pairing
providers.scope: If sum_P <u_P, (A A*)^R u_P> <= UV L^(-E_0 N), then |<f, A g>| <= C UV L^(4C - E_0) with an absolute constant C.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An elementary Kloosterman bound
providers.scope: |K_m(h, k)| <= C_eps m^(3/4 + eps) (h, k, m)^(1/4), from the fourth moment bound sum |K_m|^4 <= 2 tau_3(m) m^4 and the unit-scaling orbits.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Equidistribution of root matrices
providers.scope: For U, V >= x^delta and squarefree S <= exp(L^0.99), the primitive (u, v) with u/U, v/V and the ratio r in given intervals and root matrix congruent to g_0 mod S number UV|I_1||I_2||I_3|/(zeta(2)|SL_2(Z/S)|) + O(UV x^(-delta/200)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bonferroni's inequalities for numbers
providers.scope: For X_i in [0, 1], the product of the 1 - X_i differs from the alternating sum of the elementary symmetric functions e_0, ..., e_T by at most e_(T+1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Replacement of the root average
providers.scope: The moment divided by UV equals 1/zeta(2) times the integral over the archimedean data of the model moment, with independent uniform kernel lines at the group primes, up to O(L^(-AN)) for every A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Orphan lifespans
providers.scope: For a prime in no list, the expected damping factor is b'_p plus 1/(p + 1) times the sum over pairs of visits a < c with the same line of eta_a eta_c times the damping of the hits strictly between them.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The operator identity
providers.scope: The model moment divided by the product of the b'_p equals the sum of the histories of <b, G_0 E_0 G_1 ... E_(N-1) G_N b> with globally distinct births.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The adjoint of an edge operation
providers.scope: The adjoint of the piece of an edge that stores in the groups S and promotes in the groups I is the piece of the reversed edge that stores in I and promotes in S.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bounds for the ghost operations
providers.scope: With the Schur weight 8^(memory size), every ghost operation has norm at most e^(9K) on memories of total size at most B = ceil(L^2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A balanced box
providers.scope: If a block has a good source state, its positions have integer coordinates in a box with sides A', B', A'B' <= C_0 Y and Y^0.1 <= A', B' <= Y^0.9, in which the edge determinant is an ordinary 2 x 2 determinant.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Clean edges contract
providers.scope: For every fixed G, if A_0 >= G + 2, every clean edge piece has norm at most L^(-G).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One omission tuple
providers.scope: At a good source and outside an exceptional set of fresh draws, a promoted prime determines the omitted source labels and the other promoted primes, so the source symmetrization costs M^(-K).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Contraction of every edge
providers.scope: If A_0 >= G + 3 and 0.005 K > G + 2, every edge operation has norm at most L^(-G) on memories of total size at most B.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The cycle identity
providers.scope: The indicator that the performed values are distinct equals the sum over collections of disjoint blocks C of addresses of the products of (-1)^(|C| - 1)(|C| - 1)! times the indicators that each block is performed with equal values.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The minor moment
providers.scope: If A_0 >= E_0 + 7 and K >= 200(E_0 + 7), then sum_P <u_P, (A A*)^R u_P> <= UV L^(-E_0 N).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The minor estimate
providers.scope: With E_0 = D_1 + 4C + 2, A_0 >= E_0 + 7 and K >= 200(E_0 + 7), the minor part Q_Y^min of the determinant equation is O(XY L^(-D_1)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The major sum
providers.scope: For every fixed D the major part Q_Y^maj is O(XY L^(-D)); the twisted cancellation of alpha is used here and only here.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sparse frequencies
providers.scope: The unit intervals on which the polynomial of one isolated group prime exceeds L^(-A_s) number exp(O(L^0.91)), and the suprema of |N_beta|^2 over them add up to O(L^(2C + 1)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
